description: This file is a shell script implementing IPv6-in-IPv4 tunnel setup and teardown functionality for OpenWrt, including configuration, prefix calculation, and network checks.

methods.name: find_6to4_prefix
methods.description: Calculates the IPv6 6to4 prefix from an IPv4 address.

methods.name: test_6to4_rfc1918
methods.description: Checks if an IPv4 address falls within private or RFC 6598 address ranges.

methods.name: proto_6to4_setup
methods.description: Configures the 6to4 tunnel with provided settings, including route and address setup.

methods.name: proto_6to4_teardown
methods.description: Placeholder for tearing down the 6to4 tunnel (currently empty).

methods.name: proto_6to4_init_config
methods.description: Initializes configuration parameters for the 6to4 protocol.
